summary:
Held 1 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 5 upside misses — LR.PA +6%, ASML.AS +6%, IFX.DE +5%, BESI.AS +4%, WEIR.L +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (FRE.DE -6%, ITH.L -5%, BMW.DE -4%, BAYN.DE -4%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: LR.PA (+6.33%) — Legrand raised its 2030 targets at its Capital Markets Day (revenue €16–18B, organic growth 6–8%/yr, higher margins) on AI data-centre demand. The stock kept rallying on 30 Sep. Sources: Investing.com and Tradingpedia. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: Legrand is a €35B Euronext Paris large-cap industrial, and no strategy covers it. The catalyst was announced on 29 Sep, so most of the gap-up was already priced in by the time any signal could fire.

top_movers.catalyst: Legrand raised its 2030 targets at its Capital Markets Day (revenue €16–18B, organic growth 6–8%/yr, higher margins) on AI data-centre demand. The stock kept rallying on 30 Sep. Sources: Investing.com and Tradingpedia.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: Legrand is a €35B Euronext Paris large-cap industrial, and no strategy covers it. The catalyst was announced on 29 Sep, so most of the gap-up was already priced in by the time any signal could fire.
top_movers.suggestion: Add CAC40/Stoxx600 industrials and electrical-equipment names to the news-reactive universe. Also add a rule that lets a name enter on day 2 if it gaps up ≥5% on a Capital Markets Day upgrade and closes ≥1.5× average volume.

top_movers.catalyst: Sector-wide AI-capex rally in semi-equipment names, with ASML supported by its raised 2026 sales guidance (€43–45B) and expanded Samsung High-NA EUV collaboration. I found no single company-specific news item for today.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: ASML.AS is a large-cap Euronext Amsterdam semiconductor-equipment name that no strategy includes. The move was a broad sector re-rating with no discrete catalyst for a news-reactive bot to trigger on.
top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap EU semis (ASML.AS, ASM International, BE Semiconductor) to the momentum-trader universe, and add a sector-breadth trigger such as ≥3 semi names up ≥3% on the same day to admit them.

top_movers.catalyst: No obvious news catalyst found. Search results showed no company-specific news, so this looks like a semiconductor-equipment sector or technical move, with the stock up about 73% YTD. Quote sources disagreed on the day's gain (+1.2% vs the +5.37% given).
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: ASM.AS is a ~€48B Dutch large-cap semi-equipment name, and only macro-aligned-hmm trades it. Without a catalyst, momentum or news-reactive filters had no trigger, and a stock this extended may also fail RSI or extension caps.
top_movers.suggestion: Add ASM.AS, and the peers ASML.AS, BESI.AS and AIXA.DE, to the momentum strategy's uk-eu universe, using a relative-strength rule (e.g. top-decile 20-day return with the RSI cap raised to ~80) to catch sector-driven moves without news.

top_movers.catalyst: No company-specific catalyst found for 30 Sep. The move looks like a sector-wide European semiconductor and AI-power rally. Infineon's only recent news was the Winbond NOR Flash sale (16 Sep) and the SolarEdge AI data-centre tie-up (9 Sep).
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: IFX.DE is a large-cap (~€75B) German semiconductor listed on Xetra, and no strategy includes it. With no news catalyst, a news-reactive bot had no trigger, and a +5% sector-beta gap would probably fail a gap-size or RSI filter anyway.
top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap DAX/STOXX 600 semiconductors (IFX.DE, ASML.AS, STM.PA) to the momentum-trader universe, with a sector-breadth trigger that enters when ≥3 of them are up more than 3% at the open.

top_movers.catalyst: No company-specific catalyst found for 30 Sep; likely a sector-wide semiconductor/AI-packaging bounce. Recent news was only a buyback update (22 Sep), an AlphaValue upgrade (11 Sep) and a Morgan Stanley target cut (8 Sep).
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: BESI is a Dutch mid/large-cap semiconductor-equipment name listed only on Euronext Amsterdam. With no news catalyst, a news-reactive strategy had no trigger, and momentum strategies wouldn't hold it without it being in their universe.
top_movers.suggestion: Add BESI.AS (and peers ASML.AS, ASMI.AS) to the momentum-trader uk-eu universe as a semicap/AI-packaging basket, keeping the existing volume and RSI filters, so sector-beta days like this one can be captured.

top_movers.catalyst: No company-specific news found for 2026-09-30; likely a sector move in mining equipment, helped by recent broker support (JP Morgan target 3,800p, top pick). Search results were generic quote pages.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: Weir is a ~£7bn FTSE 100/250 mining-equipment industrial and no strategy lists it. A +3.1% move with no gap or earnings catalyst is also unlikely to pass momentum or news-reactive filters.
top_movers.suggestion: No actionable change: a +3% sector-drift day with no catalyst doesn't justify widening the universe. If wanted, add UK mining-equipment names (WEIR.L) to the momentum universe, gated on a ≥1.5× volume floor.

top_movers.catalyst: FDA warning letter to Fresenius Kabi's Melrose Park, Illinois sterile-injectables plant, made public Sept 29. It could block new drug approvals; shares fell as much as 8% intraday.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: FRE.DE is a large-cap German healthcare/DAX name that no strategy covers. It was also a sudden regulatory-headline gap-down, and the bot has no short capability to trade it.
top_movers.suggestion: Add DAX/Stoxx 600 healthcare large-caps to the news-reactive strategy's universe, with a regulatory-keyword trigger (e.g. 'FDA warning letter') that flags a >=4% single-day drop as a mean-reversion watch candidate the next session.

top_movers.catalyst: No confirmed same-day news. Ithaca Energy (UK North Sea oil and gas) has been weighed on by recent share sales from shareholders DKL Energy and Eni UK. This may be a continued overhang, or an energy-sector move.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: ITH.L is a mid-cap LSE-listed North Sea E&P with a concentrated free float. A -4.65% drop on no fresh headline is a gradual, sell-down-driven move. Momentum and news-reactive filters would see no catalyst, and the bot has no short capability.
top_movers.suggestion: Add ITH.L and similar UK energy mid-caps to the uk-eu universe, with a block-sale/placing flag (for example, a regulatory-news RNS keyword match on 'placing' or 'sell-down'). Otherwise no actionable change, since the bot is long-only.

top_movers.catalyst: BMW's Capital Markets Day (Sep 30) set out ~8,000 job cuts and a €2bn German production investment, but investors doubted the margin recovery amid China weakness and Iran-war effects. The stock fell ~7% early, then pared losses.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: BMW.DE is a large-cap German auto stock, and no strategy includes it. The move was also a scheduled event with an intraday reversal (-7% to -4%), so a gap or momentum filter would have had no clean entry.
top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap DAX/Stoxx 50 names to the news-reactive universe, and add a capital-markets-day/event-calendar gate that flags gaps of at least -5% with a partial intraday recovery for mean-reversion review.

top_movers.catalyst: No obvious news catalyst found. Reports conflict on the day's move, and the drop looks like profit-taking after the post-Supreme Court Roundup rally (52-wk high ~53.9 in July), not a fresh event.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: BAYN.DE is a large-cap German pharma/agro name that no strategy includes. The move is also a modest drift with no gap or news trigger, so a momentum or news-reactive filter would not have fired anyway.
top_movers.suggestion: No actionable change. If DAX/Xetra large caps are ever added to the universe, gate entries on a ≥3% gap with ≥1.5x average volume so that ordinary post-rally consolidation like this is not chased.
